description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1. Can you please explain New Heaven and New Earth (Isa. 65 & 66)
2. What was the significance of the pomegranate on the helm of the priest.
3. How does one honor parents that profess to be Christian but in private are not living a Christin life
4. Is it wrong for a Christian to practice Yoga
.
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
